<function name="GetMaxHealth" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the max health that the entity was given. It can be set via <page>Entity:SetMaxHealth</page>.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">Max health.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Prints the maximum health set for player 1.</description>
	<code>print( Entity( 1 ):GetMaxHealth() )</code>
	<output>By default, 100.</output>

</example>
